content: Same pair. Atom 11 on ligand 1 is the azine carbon carrying the trifluoromethyl at atom 12, so I can change the C4 group with the cyclopentyl cap held fixed. That cap caps QED near 0.82, so this episode is for the activity reading rather than for Phi. The target is a dimethylamino, and the reason is ligand 2: methylamino reached 0.61, the joint-best activity of the whole scan, but posted only QED 0.788 because its extra N-H pushed the molecule to three donors and raised polar surface. Dimethylamino keeps everything that presumably earned the 0.61 - a bulky, strongly donating nitrogen substituent of almost the same size - while removing that donor hydrogen entirely. If it holds 0.61, then pairing it with a cyclopropyl cap in the next generation gives a molecule with the best activity available and none of the drug-likeness penalty the methylamino carried. If it drops, the donor hydrogen was doing the work rather than the nitrogen's bulk, which is worth knowing too.
